{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies CMakeLists.txt and cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in to compute and validate CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR and CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR paths for installation.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes CMake install path handling so installed binaries locate libexec components on distributions with non-default layouts like Arch Linux. Issue #35785 reported that on Arch Linux, commands failed immediately with 'execvp failed to execute ... No such file or directory' because hardcoded bin/libexec paths did not match CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR=lib."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly modifies the multiprocess bitcoin wrapper in src/bitcoin.cpp and its build glue to correctly locate internal process binaries such as bitcoin-node.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Ensures the multiprocess wrapper can successfully spawn internal target executables when installed under non-default distribution paths. Issue #35785 demonstrated that subcommands like 'bitcoin -m node' failed with 'execvp failed to execute ... No such file or directory' because the wrapper hardcoded internal binary locations."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes the command lookup logic of the bitcoin wrapper tool in src/bitcoin.cpp and adds test/functional/tool_bitcoin.py.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves a fatal execution bug in the bitcoin wrapper CLI tool on systems configured with non-standard installation directories. Issue #35785 noted that installed wrapper commands failed completely with 'execvp failed to execute' on Arch Linux due to rigid directory assumptions."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
